events.what: Adams, Ionov, Mason-Brown and Vogan claim a proof that all Arthur packets of real reductive groups consist of unitary representations (and Jiang's conjecture for real groups)
Yang extends the 'Arthur-packet support equality' posed alongside the June paper
Proof of Vogan's conjecture on Arthur packets for GL_n over p-adic fields

judgement.doubts: The bullet names the whole of Arthur's conjectures (global multiplicity formula, local packets over all fields, unitarity, Ramanujan implications); the June 2026 paper settles only the unitarity part over the reals, which is a case. It remains unreviewed; Pith Review is automated and not digestion. The 2023 GL_n p-adic result is pre-snapshot and cannot set the status.

corrections.why: F1/F2: the bullet is the broad 'Arthur's conjectures', and the record's competing_reading itself says that other parts (the endoscopic classification and multiplicity formula, non-quasi-split and non-archimedean cases) remain conjectural. Unitarity of Arthur packets for real groups is one part, so it is a case, which makes it partial whatever its review status.
